**Build's clean. Exit 0.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw whenever a flag was `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats anything but `true` as disabled.

The rest was just deprecation noise from the dep bump, harmless. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
